reason: Removes forced version pins for previously known-vulnerable transitive dependencies (System.Drawing.Common, System.Runtime.Caching, System.Text.RegularExpressions, System.Private.Uri) and reorganizes renovate rules, so it could reintroduce security-vulnerable transitive package versions even though it's otherwise just build/dependency tooling config with no app code changes.
